description: Point-source exposure-rate constants for the pydecay core-40 nuclides. Coefficients are nuclear-photon emission values; X-rays and photons below 30 keV are omitted (Risoe-M-2322 sec. 1). gamma_R_cm2_mCi_h stores true R.cm2.mCi-1.h-1 (= 10 x the Risoe R.m2/h/Ci value); gamma_R_m2_h_per_Ci keeps the verbatim source value for provenance.
